verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair axis for a developer-facing payments API, but nothing in the pack documents one for Agentic Commerce. The evidence shows markdown docs, llms.txt, an MCP server, a CLI sandbox and a field reference, none of which is an interactive runnable reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The sandbox CLI and MCP server are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
